title: Excellent Experience!
text:
I rented the camper van Tomatina for three days and honestly couldn't have made a better decision! The owner was super friendly and took the time to explain everything I needed to know before hitting the road.

The van had everything I needed, and I spent three amazing days exploring the beautiful nature north of Barcelona!

Would 100% recommend it to anyone looking to escape the city for a few days and have a little adventure!
author: danielgV5963KP

title: Vermut, Costa Brava
text:
Vermut, Costa Brava

We had Vermut for four days and drove along the Costa Brava. It was incredibly cool. The coastal road with the T2 at 80 km/h is exactly the right pace; you stop constantly because there is a bay somewhere, and someone waves in every town. The driving itself is the experience; with a normal car, the route would have just been a route.

author: hannesb852

title: An unforgettable journey! 🚐❤️
text:
Every road we travelled with Tomatina was part of an incredible adventure.
Pure vibes, freedom, and unforgettable memories. We absolutely recommend it — it was a week we’ll never forget! 🏔️☀️🚐

And Tomatina herself will always have a special place in our hearts. ❤️
author: 811korneliak

title: Fantastic Lenny!!
text:
Lenny was an excellent travel companion!
He welcomed us with his classic yet modern style, with all the necessary and sustainable accessories.
The owner is a very helpful, passionate, and meticulous person. He explains every feature in detail and makes sure of everything before departure, including the ability to drive the vehicle.
We strongly recommend watching the explanatory videos on his website.
Thank you Lenny for this experience, we will come back to visit you!!
author: E6632WRlucam

title: The perfect gift for a different kind of weekend
text:

title: An adventure of a lifetime
text:
There are experiences that you book thinking it's going to be "just another tour," and then there are experiences like this one, which stay with you as if time had stopped for a while just for you. title: Wonderful trip around Barcelona with Tomatina
text: Wonderful trip in Catalonia with an old campervan in good condition that can handle the mountain roads! Everything needed is in the camper and we got great tips from the owner throughout the trip.
author: morganemN8002ND

title: Amazing Trip with "Vinny" the VW Camper Van
text: My son and I absolutely loved our experience in "Vinny" the VW Camper Van. Check in went smooth. Nicolas had prepared a video for us to watch prior to arriving which gave great details of what we needed to know about "Vinny". He taught us all the in's and out's of operating the van when we arrived and even took us on a quick drive to make sure we felt comfortable driving "Vinny" on our own. We used one of the road trip plans on the "Advantura" website as a reference and then added in our own little diversions along the way. The Costa Brava was gorgeous, and we loved visiting the medieval towns
author: BearratLife

title: Tomatina
text:
Super nice experience. Tomatina (the bus) was very basic but therefore authentic. The communication with the owner was very pleasant, a quick answer to everything. Very accessible. 
The bus took us to the mountains of Barcelona in the most beautiful places. Don't expect elaborate luxury but just get back to basics and take it easy. 
The owner explains everything well and clearly and then you can go out yourself. Much is based on trust. For lovers, this is really a pearl. Had a unique time.
author: 965jannies

text: Great experience. Nicolas explained everything in detail so we could hit the road safely and securely. Tomatina is a beautiful camper that has clearly been taken care of with a lot of love.
